paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih, Babulon leh Kaldai mite tung ah, hihse ding huihpi ka sawl ding hi.
heading: Babulon A Dia Thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.

paite: Zapsiangmi ka sawl ding, Babulon tung ah, amah zap in agam azapsiang ding ua, siatna ni a um a sual ding ahi ngal ua.
english: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.

paite: Thalpeu zangmi in thalpeu lai a, sik puanak silh in, dingh heh, tangvalhon khat leng hawi lou in, asepaih tengteng nuaimang un.
english: Against him who bends, let the archer bend his bow, also against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail. Don’t spare her young men! Utterly destroy all her army!

paite: Kaldai gam ah thah in apuk ding ua, akholakte uah sut pailet in a-om ding uhi.
english: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.

paite: Israel leh Judah, agam uah Israel Mi Siangthou tung ah khelhna in adim na ua, a Pathian uh sepaihte' TOUPA'N amangngilh kei hi.
english: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God, by Yahweh of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Taimang unla, Babulon khosung a kipan, michih in amah hinna humbit hen; athulimlouhna manloh kei un, TOUPA phulak hun ahi ngal a, ama'n athuk ngeigngei ding hi.
english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of Yahweh’s vengeance. He will give to her a recompense.

paite: Babulon bel TOUPA khut a dangka-eng nou, leitung pumpi hihkhamna ahi a, namte'n kham in alung uh amawl khinta hi.
english: Babylon has been a golden cup in Yahweh’s hand, who made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.

paite: Babulon apuk guih a, amangta, amah kah ekek un, hihdam theihdan ding ahihleh singnai damdawi nuhchi laksak un.
english: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.

paite: Babulon hihdam ka tum a, adam tuan kei, amah nusia in eimah gam chiat uah pai ni, amohna in van asun a, van dum pha a dopkang ahi.
english: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her judgment reaches to heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

paite: "TOUPA'N ka dikna apuangta; kisa un, TOUPA i Pathian thilhih, Zion ah i puang ding uh.
english: ‘Yahweh has produced our righteousness. Come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.’

paite: "Thalte tat-hiam unla, lumte len un, Media kumpipate lungsim TOUPA'N atokthouta a, athiltup Babulon hihsiat ahi. Huai TOUPA'N atempul ziak a phulakna ahi.
english: “Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it; for it is the vengeance of Yahweh, the vengeance of his temple.

paite: Babulon kulh bul ah kidouna puangzak thak un, venna hihhat in, galvilmi koih un, galbuknate bawl unla, Babulon mite tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N agen tak, angaihtuah in ahih khinta hi.
english: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon! Make the watch strong! Set the watchmen, and prepare the ambushes; for Yahweh has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.

paite: Aw nang, tui tamna mun a tengmi, sum-le-pai hau mahmah, na tawpna atungta, na hinna khau akitanta hi.
english: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA amah kilou in achiamta hi, khaupete bang mai in mihing in ka hon dimsak ngeingei ding, nakpi in ahon otkhum ding uh."
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, ‘Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, and they will lift up a shout against you.’

paite: Athilhihtheihna in lei abawl a, apilna in khovel adingkhesak a, alemtheihna in van aphalhsak.
heading: Pathian Phatna La
english: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.

paite: A-aw asuah a, van a tui aging hawhaw a, kawlmong a kipan meipi apaitousak a, vuah zukna ding in khua aphesak a, agoubawm a kipan huih anungsak hi.
english: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

paite: Michih amual ua, theihna lou in, dangka-eng sekmichih in alimsek pen azumpih ua, amilim sun lah zuau ngen ahi a, amau ah nakna a-om kei lai hi.
english: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

paite: Bangmah lou, khemna nasep lel ahi ua, agawt hun chiang in amang ding uh.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.

paite: Jakob tantuan bel hichibang ahi kei, thil tengteng bul ahi ngal a; Israel agouluah nam ahi a, amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he formed all things, including the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Nang bel ka galdouna heipi leh vanzat na hi a, nang hon zang in namte ka hihzan a, nang zang in lalna gamte ka hihmang hi.
heading: TOUPA Khetbuk
english: “You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy kingdoms.

paite: Nang hon zang in sakol leh atung a ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in kangtalai leh atung a tuang ka hihzan a;
english: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.

paite: Nangmah zang in numei leh pasal ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in putek leh tuailai ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in nungak leh tangval ka hihzan hi.
english: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.

paite: Nangmah zang in belamching leh belamhon ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in louneimi leh bawngtal kop ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in gam ukpipate leh upate ka hihzan sek ahi.
english: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock. With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke. With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies.

paite: Nang mitmuh ngei in Zion tung a athil hoih lou hih tengteng uh Babulon leh Kaldai mite tung ah ka thuk ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
heading: Babulon Tung A Gawtna
english: “I will give to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai in, leitung pumpi hihsia, aw hihsetu tang lian, nang ka hon dou ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, kawl sang a kipan ka hon khukkhe ding, tang kang mit khinsa in ka hon bawl ding.
english: “Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says Yahweh, “which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand on you, roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain.

paite: Nang a kipan suang ning ding leh suangphum ding lakkhiak ahi nawn kei ding; tangtawn in na segawp zaw ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Huai gam ah kidou puanzak tak unla, namte lak ah pengkul mut un, amah dou ding namte kisasak unla, Araratte, Minnite, Ashkenaz gamte, amah sual ding sepaih sep unla, khaupe zuanzaang bang mai in sakolte kaikhawm un.
english: “Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!

paite: Amah dou ding namte kisasak un; Media kumpipate, ukpipate leh upate, athuneihna gam tengteng toh.
english: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion!

paite: Huai gam nat thuak in aling a, Babulon gam, tengmi om lou a hihsiat ding in, Babulon tung a TOUPA thiltup adingh gige hi.
english: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of Yahweh against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.

paite: Babulon galdou mite'n galkap ding ngapta lou in, akulhpi uah aton maimah uh, apasalphatna uh akhing a, numei bang mai ahong hita ua, atenna munte akang khin a, adeidanna siktawn akitan hi.
english: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.

paite: Thangkou tai in midang leng akituahpih a, misawl in leng midang atuak a, Babulon kumpipa kiang a akhopi ning chih ah amanta uh chih hilh ding in.
english: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter.

paite: Lui kannate aman ua, phailuangte ahal siang ua, kidou mite leng alunglelta uh.
english: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Babulon tanu phual sikngil lai bang ahi a, sawt lou nung in buhchil hun atung ah ahong tung ding hi."
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden. Yet a little while, and the time of harvest comes for her.”

paite: "Hon negaita, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in, hon haizan a, bel vuak lel in ahon bawlta, gulpi bang in ahon nawmvalhta, ka thil limte'n agilpi adimsak a, ahon paikhe nawnta hi.
english: “Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me. He has crushed me. He has made me an empty vessel. He has, like a monster, swallowed me up. He has filled his mouth with my delicacies. He has cast me out.

paite: Kei leh ka satung a hiamgam thilhih, Babulon tung ah om hen; ka sisan Kaldai mite tung ah om hen, Jerusalem in achi ding."
english: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea!” will Jerusalem say.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, nang lam ah ka pang ding a, na phu ka hon laksak ding, atuipi ka kangsak ding a, atuikhuk leng ka keugawsak ding.
heading: TOUPA'N Israel Apanpih Ding
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

paite: Huan Babulon bel hoih lou paihkhawm lel, sehal tenna mun, lamdangsak chiat leh enghou, tengmi om lou mun ahong hi ding.
english: Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.

paite: Akikou ton ding ua, humpinelkai lun lai bang in, angik tuaktuak ding uh; humpinelkai nou bang in.
english: They will roar together like young lions. They will growl as lions’ cubs.

paite: Akham mahmah lai un ankuang ka luisak dia, khothei het lou in ka khamsak dia, khanglou het lou ding a a-ihmut dettheihna ding un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: When they are inflamed, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ka pikhe ding a, belam goh ding bang in, belamtalte leh keltalte bang mai in."
english: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.

paite: Shesak lak ahita ve; leitung pumpi pahtawi zel mat in a-omta ve, namte lak ah Babulon asegawpta ve.
heading: Babulon Tuah Ding
english: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

paite: Babulon tuipi in atumta, akihot thupi mahmah in akhuh khinta.
english: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.

paite: Akhopi asegawpta a, gamkeu, gamdai, mihing tenlouhna mihing ta kuamah phak louh gam ahong suakta hi.
english: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it.

paite: Babulon bel ka gawt ding, avalhkhitsa akam a kipan asuahkhe ding, namte bel akiang ah aluangkhawm nawn kei ding uh, ahi Babulon kulhpi achim ding.
english: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up. The nations will not flow any more to him. Yes, the wall of Babylon will fall.

paite: Ka mite aw, asung a kipan hong pawt unla, TOUPA hehna lauhuai mahmah a kipan, michih amau kihumbit chiat un.
english: “My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from Yahweh’s fierce anger.

paite: Na lungtang uh bah kei hen, huai gam a thuthang leng lau kei un; kum khat in thuthang ahong tung ding a, kum dang in thuthang ahong tung nawn ding ahi, kumpipa leh kumpipa kisual in gam ah hiamgamna a-om ding.
english: Don’t let your heart faint. Don’t fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi. Babulon milim sektawmte tung a vai ka hawm a, agam pumpi zumna ni ding; huan, asung ah amithahte apuk ding uh.
english: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.

paite: Huchi in lei leh van leh asung a om tengteng in, Babulon tung a kipak in la asa ding uh; mallam a kipan sim mite akiang a tung ding uh ahi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says Yahweh.

paite: Babulon in Israel mithahte apuksak bang in Babulon ah gam chih a thah a omte apuk ding uh.
english: “As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.

paite: Nou namsau pel mite aw, kuan unla, dingh maimai kei un, gamlapi a kipan in TOUPA theigige unla, na lungsim uah Jerusalem lut hen.
heading: Babulon A Israel Kiang A TOUPA Thugen
english: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember Yahweh from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”

paite: Gensiatna thu ka zak ziak un ka zum ua, lungdonna in ka mai uh atuam a, TOUPA' inn a mun siangthoute ah pau theih louh mite ahong lutta uhi.
english: “We are confounded because we have heard reproach. Confusion has covered our faces, for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, amilim sektawmte uh tung a ka vaihawmna ding leh agam pumpi tung a miliamte thumna ni ding ngei.
english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded will groan.

paite: Babulon bel van sun in sang mahleh, akulh sangte hihkip mahleh, atung ah ka kiang a kipan hihsemi ahong tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet destroyers will come to her from me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Babulon a kipan kah husa leh Kaldai gam a kipan siatna thupitak husa;
english: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!

paite: TOUPA'N Babulon asim a, ahusa uh thupitak ahih daihsak hi. Agamtat husa uh tui tampi ging hawhaw bang ahi, a- awng zuazualua.
english: For Yahweh lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice! Their waves roar like many waters. The noise of their voice is uttered.

paite: Atung ah simmi ahong tung, Babulon tung ngei ah pang ni, amihatte mat in a-om ua, athalpeute uh akitangawpta, TOUPA bel thukna Pathian ahi a, athuk ngeingei ding.
english: For the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon. Her mighty men are taken. Their bows are broken in pieces, for Yahweh is a God of retribution. He will surely repay.

paite: Huan aheutute leh amipilte, a-ukpipate leh upate leh mihatte ka khamsak dia; alumden ding ua, akhanglou kei ding uh, chih, kumpipa, Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Babulon kumpipa kulhbaang sahtakte achim vek ding a, akongpi sangte akang vek ding; amite'n athawn in asem ua, namte'n meihal a ding lel a kihihgim uh ana hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire. The peoples will labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they will be weary.”

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah vaihawm akum lina a Babulon ahoh lai a akiang a hoh sam, Seraiah Neriah tapa, Maaseiah tapa kiang a zawlnei Jeremiah thupiak.
heading: Jeremiah Thukhah Babulon Akhakna
english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.

paite: Seraiah bel kumpipa insung heutupen ahi a, Jeremiah in Babulon tung a siatna hong tung ding tengteng, Babulon tungtang a hiai thu gelh tengteng laibu ah agelh hi.
english: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in Seraiah kiang ah, Babulon na tun hun chiang in hiai thu tengteng sim ngeingei inla,
english: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,

paite: Aw TOUPA hiai nam tungtang ah kuamah, mi leh sa leh tenlouhna ding suksiat a om in, tangtawn a kisegawp zaw ding in thu na genta a, na chi ding.
english: and say, ‘Yahweh, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor animal, but that it will be desolate forever.’

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, hiai laibu na sim khit chiang in suang toh gakkhawm in Euphrates Luipi ah pailut inla,
english: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.

paite: Babulon hichibang mai in atum ding a, atung a siatna ka hon tut ding ziak in athounawn kei ding; abah mahmah ding uh, chi in na gen ding ahi, achi a. Hichi teng Jeremiah thu ahi.
english: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
